title: Headings and Paragraphs
prompt:
Create a short page about your favorite place.

  • Use an <h1> with the text My Favorite Place.
  • Add a paragraph (<p>) that contains the word because.
  • Add a second-level heading (<h2>) with the text Details.

html.starter:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <title>My Favorite Place</title>
</head>
<body>
  <!-- Add your headings and paragraph here -->

</body>
</html>

tests.name: HTML validates
tests.feedback: Fix the HTML validation errors shown in the test details (for example, close your tags).

tests.name: h1 says My Favorite Place
tests.feedback: The h1 text should be exactly "My Favorite Place".

tests.name: Paragraph mentions because
tests.feedback: Your paragraph should include the word "because".

solution.html:
My Favorite Place

I like the library because it is quiet and full of books.

Details
